plugins.name: brightops-wiki
plugins.description: Global auto-capture wiki for Claude Code. Captures durable conclusions from any session via a Stop hook, accumulates them in an inbox, and compiles them into project-organized synthesis pages on a /loop schedule. Hybrid of Karpathy's compile-first wiki and MemPalace's hook-driven capture.
